Section note before editing `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` (seat 5's epic #35590 fence, the record page redo split) · 2026-11-20T00:40Z

Area ux-1 takes #35595 and #35596 folded into one branch. In `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` at c03a8a3428 it changes:
- `synthTabs` (around 943-1033): the tab list itself, meaning the Overview naming, every ordinary related list as its own tab with no fold-by-records, and the attachments, approvals and activity tabs. It ⛔ does not touch the `isBody` / `bodies` split around 972-980.
- `buildDefaultTabs` (around 916).
- `buildDefaultPageSchema`'s assembly (around 1088-1209): the highlight strip and stage path move from above the tabs into the Overview tab's top, full width.
- `buildDefaultAttachments` / `buildDefaultTimeline` only where a tab or the rail needs them.

It ⛔ does not touch `bodyTablePlacement` (825-~915), `BODY_TABLE_PAGE_SIZE`, the `isBody` option in `BuildPageOptions`, or anything else ux-2's #35597 (PR #35691) edits. Whichever PR lands second merges main.

- **Right-column switch (around 5108):** it is no longer drawn when the page is embedded. A drawer or pane draws no rail, so the switch would do nothing there.
- **Open-PR scan, taken at the time stamped above:** no open PR touches `RecordDetailView.tsx`. The header region's own PR, #35679, has merged.

Close-out · 2026-11-20T08:43Z: PR #35763 merged as b0c624af8c. It folds #35595 and #35596. L1-a gave ACCEPT 7032791068, and the seat ran the Tier H approver handoff (7033230940). This card closed on the merge.

What changed:
- The record page opens on Overview. The stage bar and key fields sit only there, at full width.
- Every related list gets its own tab. An empty list's tab is greyed with no number, and tabs fold into 「更多」 only by width.
- Attachments, Approvals and Activity are tabs. The page foot no longer carries an approval band or an attachment card.
- An authored page draws its approval band once.
- This supersedes #28469.

Follow-up: #35783 (p1, the maintainer's 「先合并，另开卡恢复」) brings back move, hide and reset on the tab menus.
